en-US.name: Hugo (Deploy)
en-US.releaseNotes: The big change in this release is that the extended edition of Hugo is gone. LibSass has been deprecated for a long time, and it was the main reason we needed a CGO-enabled extended build. There is now only one Hugo binary, and apart from LibSass it has all the features the extended build had. Notes - Setting transpiler to libsass in css.Sass now returns an error. Dart Sass is now the default and the only transpiler, so you need to install it if you use Sass. - We no longer publish hugo_extended_* archives. To avoid breaking existing CI setups, we publish aliases for the most downloaded extended archives (e.g. hugo_extended__linux-amd64.tar.gz, hugo_extended__Linux-64bit.tar.gz, the linux-amd64.deb, linux-arm64.tar.gz and windows-amd64.zip), but you should update your scripts to use the standard archives. The extended_withdeploy builds are also removed. See Installation. - hugo.IsExtended now always returns false, and the module config setting hugoVersion.extended is deprecated and has no effect. - Command-line flags (e.g. --buildDrafts) now override OS environment variables (e.g. HUGO_BUILDDRAFTS). This also fixes HUGO_ENVIRONMENT=qa hugo build -e staging loading the staging config but reporting qa in hugo.Environment. - strings.Truncate has been rewritten on top of a proper HTML scanner. It now handles comments, void elements, quoted attributes with > and raw text elements such as script correctly, and it's faster and allocates less. On a curious note, the old version was implemented by Mathias Biilmann, the Netlify CEO. - time.Time values now keep their named time zone, and eq, ne, in and uniq compare time.Time values by instant. - resources.Match and friends now preserve the directory casing in the matched paths, so e.g. resources.Match "gallery/Travel/Iceland/*" now works on case-sensitive file systems. - Syncing of static files is much faster for big unchanged files, as we now skip the content check for files with the same size and modification time. - Several fixes and hardening of the WASM based image codecs (AVIF crash at encoderSpeed 6 and lower, recovering from broken WASM instances in the server). Security Hugo - Passthrough content is now HTML escaped when no passthrough render hook is set, unless markup.goldmark.renderer.unsafe is enabled. Before this, e.g. \(\) in a content file emitted raw HTML. - The wrapperClass option, settable from the highlight shortcode and transform.Highlight, is now escaped. - Vendored module paths are now restricted to the _vendor directory (symlinks pointing outside are rejected). Thanks to @R0X4R for finding and reporting the last two issues. Go This release is built with Go 1.27.4, which includes 12 security fixes. The one most relevant for Hugo is a crash in the net/http HTTP/1 server (used by hugo server) caused by a race in MaxBytesReader. The other 11 are in the cmd/go toolchain (cgo flag and linker injection at build time) and mainly matter if you build Hugo from source with untrusted dependencies. Dependencies - golang.org/x/net v0.62.0 fixes two issues in the html package: quadratic complexity when coalescing text nodes, and a namespace issue when rendering raw text. Hugo uses this package when collecting HTML elements for hugo_stats.json and in the AsciiDoc integration. - github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 v4.1.6 (indirect dependency) contains a number of security fixes, among them GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q (RSA modulus size limit when parsing JWKs) and a stack depth limit in the JSON decoder.
